title: Who Wears What - Ki mit visel?
grammar: visel + accusative; indefinite and definite endings of visel

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what someone wears, like Anna kék kabátot visel and Fehér inget viselek.
I can ask what someone is wearing, like Mit visel Károly? and Mit viselsz ma?
I can say that I or they wear a particular item, like Viselem a fekete sapkát and Ők viselik a szürke nadrágot.
